items.titulo: Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh: A Multi-Agent Harness for 1,024 Agents
items.resumen: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator. Self-organizing workers share a Git repo, chat and a findings board, scaling from 1 to 1,024 agents on ProgramBench under a 6-hour budget.
